for i in range(len(df.columns[: -1])):
    label = df.columns[i]
    # Line 3
    plt.hist(df[df["target"] == 1][label], color="blue", label="Yes", alpha=0.5, density=True, bins=15)

    plt.hist(df[df["target"] == 0][label], color="red", label="No", alpha=0.5, density=True, bins=15)
    plt.title("label")
    plt.xlabel("label")
    plt.ylabel("probability")
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()
